verdict.rationale: x402 documents a public, API-driven flow for AI agents: discovery APIs and a generated OpenAPI client requiring no CDP API key, an MCP-compatible Bazaar server for tool-call discovery, and agentic wallet/CDP SDK building blocks for agents to pay and consume services programmatically. This directly matches the 'AI-native user drives the product via documented public API' story, though the probe found no live openapi.json/swagger spec at the root docs domain and there's no independent hands-on confirmation of the discovery API contract. missing for 10: a verified live public OpenAPI/swagger spec, independent developer confirmation of API usage beyond docs.
